license_snapshots.name: Kenney support grant statement
license_snapshots.text: Can I use the game assets in a (commercial) project? Yes, all game assets on the asset pages are public domain licensed (CC0). You’re free to use them, even in commercial projects. For full details, see the included license file or visit the asset page. Is attribution required when using the game assets? Attribution is not required, but if you choose to give credit you can do so by mentioning "Kenney". Do not use our logo, as it is reserved for official projects by our studio. How can I use the game assets in my game engine? Unfortunately, we’re unable to provide support for importing assets into specific game engines. We recommend consulting the knowledge base or the documentation/community

reference_sets.real_place_reference: none acquired; gated on BLOCK-CHOICE owner decision (location + scrubbed-set permission). Rule: no identifiable people/private personal data (BP-SECU-02).

generated_works_rule: No generated assets at RIGHTS. BP-PRES-06 generated variant applies from MESH-FIRST on: generating tool/service + version (where known) + prompt/input reference as source/author provenance; license/service terms + permitted use still required and must permit distribution/runtime use; incomplete entries are excluded from submission builds. ACT-CREA-01 Muse Image outputs follow this rule with the pre-authored local variant as fallback.
exclusion_rule: An asset missing any applicable BP-PRES-06 field, with incompatible terms, or without a register entry is excluded from submission builds until complete (SEIT-PRES-06-N1/N2/N3, SEIT-IF-ASSET-N1..N5, SEIT-TB-07-N1..N4/N6). Reconciliation of the final build asset list occurs at RIGHTS-FINAL.

scan.credential_findings: none: no secret rules fired; artifacts are binary 3D/audio/font data plus plain-text license/readme/.url stubs (inspected: .url stubs contain only kenney.nl/patreon URLs).
